content.comment_body: Hello, I am unsure if the issue is caused by [product_name] [version_no], or if I've made an error, but I'm unable to view the value of an hour counter (VD) on the Webserver when the value surpasses 65535. For OT values at 1092h (65520m), it works fine. However, at 1093h (65580), the result is 'unsupported.' I don't understand why, since it's a VD and not a VW.
Please upload your [product_name] project and [product_name] program in a zip file.

The complete error message in this scenario is 'Unsupported data type.' This is a confirmed software bug in [product_name] [version_no]. Although you can choose the VD data format, any value in VD0 above 65535 triggers the error. The development team should add this issue to their 'to do' list.
That's what I suspected. Thank you for testing it yourself.
Hello, I am experiencing the same issue and would like to know if there's a solution to display hour counter values greater than 65536 minutes on the Webserver.
Currently, there is no alternative solution to this. [company_name] needs to resolve this bug in [product_name].
Hello again, Do you have any idea when this issue might be fixed? We require this feature for a major project.
I'm not associated with [company_name]; only they can provide an answer regarding the solution timeline.

I attempted to print large values with scale time using [product_name] [version_no] and encountered the same 'unsupported data type' message. So far, I can only display large values as analog types. As using scale time for OT of the hour counter seems logical, I have notified the development team. I do not know how long it will take for them to address this.

analysis.insight_summary: Users consistently face a limitation with [product_name] [version_no], where hour counter values exceeding 65535 are not displayed on the Webserver and trigger an 'Unsupported data type' error. Multiple users and support participants confirm this is a software defect, which hinders those who need to visualise large hour values for their projects. The software's data processing capabilities currently do not meet these user requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the product to reliably display all VD hour counter values, even those above 65535, without any errors. This functionality is vital for larger projects that require accurate and comprehensive time monitoring.
